siteRouting.name: Site routing rules

service.error_not_published: This document is not published to Halo yet
service.error_upload_images_failed_publish_abort: {{failed}} image(s) failed to upload. Publishing was aborted.
service.error_term_not_applied: "{{name}}" could not be applied to the post: the site did not return its resource name. The post will be published without it — add it in the Halo console, then publish again.
service.error_image_too_large: "{{name}}" exceeds {{limit}} MiB and this site has no personal access token configured, so it cannot be uploaded: MCP base64 uploads have that hard limit, and the REST fallback needs a PAT. Compress the image, or add a PAT in the site settings.
service.notice_taxonomy_not_resolved: The category/tag names could not be read from the site, so the fields that failed were left as they are in the note (nothing was written for them). Everything else was written as usual; retry this operation later to fill them in.
service.error_unknown_rule_site: The routing rule "{{pattern}}" points to a site ({{url}}) that is not in the site list. Fix the rule in Settings → Halo.
service.notice_list_truncated: The {{what}} list is incomplete — only the first {{size}} were loaded.

error.protocol: MCP protocol error: the server returned HTTP 400 with an empty body. This usually means the handshake order is wrong (initialize must come first), or the Accept header is missing text/event-stream.
error.unauthorized: The MCP key is invalid or has expired. Check the access key under Tools -> MCP Service in the Halo console.
error.forbidden: This MCP key is not authorized to call that tool. Grant the tool to the key under Tools -> MCP Service in the Halo console.
error.gateway: The site returned HTML instead of JSON. Either a gateway (ESA/WAF) blocked the request, or the MCP Server plugin is not enabled / the endpoint is wrong — Halo then answers with its theme's 404 page, which is also HTML. Confirm the site is reachable, the plugin is enabled, and <site>/mcp is the correct endpoint.
error.missing-tool: The site does not provide the MCP tool "{{tool}}" ({{count}} tool(s) available). Confirm the site runs Halo >= 2.26 with the MCP Server plugin enabled, and check this key's tool grants.
error.network: Could not reach the MCP endpoint. Check the site URL and your network.
error.unknown: The MCP request failed. Check the site configuration and the Halo console.

frontmatter.error_visible: The value "{{value}}" of `halo.visible` is invalid: it must be one of PUBLIC, INTERNAL, PRIVATE.
frontmatter.error_boolean: The value "{{value}}" of `halo.{{field}}` is invalid: it must be an unquoted true or false.
frontmatter.error_integer: The value "{{value}}" of `halo.{{field}}` is invalid: it must be an integer.
frontmatter.error_string: The value "{{value}}" of `halo.{{field}}` is invalid: it must be a string.
frontmatter.error_publish_time: The value "{{value}}" of `halo.publishTime` is not a recognizable time. Use RFC 3339 (e.g. 2026-10-06T10:00:00+08:00); use an empty string "" to publish immediately.

batch.notice_rewrites_notes: Note: local notes are rewritten too
batch.notice_rewrites_notes_desc: The run writes the post metadata (title / slug / cover / excerpt / categories / tags) and the whole `halo` block back into the notes. With "Replace image links" enabled, local image paths are replaced with Halo URLs as well.
batch.skip_needs_choice: Several sites are available but none is the default and no routing rule matched — set a routing rule or a default site in the settings.
batch.skip_no_sites: No site has been configured yet.
batch.skip_unknown_site: The halo.site value in the note ({{url}}) is not in the site list.
batch.skip_unknown_rule_site: The routing rule "{{pattern}}" points to a site ({{url}}) that is no longer in the site list.
batch.skip_not_published: Not published to Halo yet (no halo.name) — there is nothing to unpublish.
batch.skip_unreadable: The note could not be read (its content or images are unavailable) — it was left out of this batch.
batch.error_no_candidates: No notes to process in batch.
batch.summary_line: {{success}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed, and {{skipped}} were skipped before the run.
